title: Round 49 (F355): Chat input + command dispatch - 0x404600 dual-buffer restore + 0x41ED20 command dispatch ('+' -> 0x41E740 trade/counter; msgid-6 byte table 0x421D8C -> jump table 0x421D5C) + sim chat command wiring (browser-verified +/@/!/plain)
objective: Decode the chat input and command dispatch: 0x404600 (dual-buffer restore + SetWindowTextA + EM_SETSEL/SetFocus chain), 0x41ED20 (command parser: '+' trade, msgid dispatch table), and wire chat commands into the simulator.
question: How does the original handle chat input and commands, and does the sim dispatch them?
